svg.title: Showreel. Ronald Ajusan: full-stack, QA testing, Stellar Web3, lead developer at HeyPay. Then clips from events: presenting HeyPay at Builder Showcase × WOCEE 2026, SMX Convention Center; the Artisam Labs booth at Blockquest Fiesta, Cabuyao; onboarding new users at Asia Pacific College, Makati; walking a user through HeyPay at Blockquest Fiesta; presenting at StellarX Demo Day 3.
